title: Select
description: CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>.
when: One value from a short or medium list (printers, regions).
A compact sort / group control in a toolbar (variant="toolbar").

instead.need: A long list the user types into

a11y: A listbox button: Enter / Space / arrows open it, type-ahead jumps, Escape closes and returns focus.
